story: I hold a master's degree in software engineering, with research in intelligent algorithms, computer vision and data mining. I have worked on data collection, cleaning, modelling and experiments in research projects, and on object detection, knowledge graphs, analytics and web systems in engineering work.

I work in an engineering-minded way: clarify the problem and constraints first, build the smallest verifiable solution, then optimise. Beyond code, I care about documentation, reproducibility and delivery quality — the things that let someone else pick the work up.

I am currently doing independent work on AI data applications while building up embedded and Verilog skills. My goal is to connect algorithms, data and systems into products that are genuinely usable and maintainable.
This site is a sample of that approach: static-first, content and code in one repository, quality gates automated. It is both a portfolio and an engineering record that keeps being maintained.

principles.title: Verify before optimising
principles.body: Get the smallest closed loop working, validate it with real data or experiments, then invest in performance and architecture.

principles.title: Documentation is part of delivery
principles.body: Write down constraints, decisions and reproduction steps so the next person can take over, not just inherit code.

principles.title: Reproducibility first
principles.body: Pin dependencies, record environments and keep check scripts; conclusions should be runnable again.
